correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py independently: E1 associativity on 9^3 triples OK, E2 d^2=0 OK, E3 rank(delta0)=2 rank(delta1)=8 giving HH1=k^2 HH2=0, E4 Bardzell AP2 full rank 4 cross-check OK, E5 two HH1 cocycles certified non-coboundaries. Manually verified delta0/delta1 formulas for a1b1,a1b2,a2b1,a2b2 blocks, dimension counts C0=k^3 C1=k^12 C2=k^8, and that full image delta1 forces HH2=0 without needing delta2. originality.rationale: Fused literature search (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref) plus full fetch of Ladkani 1208.2230 and Chaparro-Schroll-Solotar-Suarez-Alvarez 2311.08003 finds no prior evaluation of the mixed HH1-action or HH dimensions for the named once-punctured torus base algebra A0 (Markov quiver with cut c0, relations a1b1=a2b2=0, dim 9). General Tamarkin-Tsygan calculus gives machinery but no A0 matrix; Ladkani gives dimension formulas from AG-invariant but no AG table for this punctured case (Corollary 4 covers only unpunctured surfaces). No synonymous, dual, database, or dimensional implication covers the exact HH2=0/HH1=k^2 verdict. See decisive_checks for adversarial coverage tests.

value.rationale: ADMISSION_DEFECT: topic.audit_preflight cheap-falsification and target_integrity preflight expected both HH1 and HH2 nonzero (Ladkani/relation-cycle heuristic) so zero-vs-nonzero would be substantive; computation proves HH2=0, so the literal mixed-action vanishing holds in strengthened vacuous form and the nonvacuity expectation was false. Despite that defect, the strongest headline HH2(A0)=0 with HH1(A0)=k^2 for the minimal natural once-punctured torus base algebra is independently valuable: object and invariant were motivated before computation by the bracket-geometry/deformation dictionary, the exact value was not known (heuristic predicted opposite) nor mechanically implied by any table, and future cluster-surface/Fukaya/derived-equivalence researchers can cite the precise rigidity (HH2=0 means no infinitesimal deformations, stronger than bracket vanishing) with reusable Bardzell witnesses. This is an exact invariant of a natural object, not a textbook restatement or arbitrary slice.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal Perplexity check returned 20 results (5 overlapping base providers, 15 incremental URLs). The 5 overlaps merely duplicated the base general-calculus and bracket-formula sources. The 15 incremental URLs were screened literally: the only substantively relevant ones are general gentle/skew-gentle/toupie/A-infinity HH-bracket works and a duplicate Ladkani PDF plus a survey report, verified where decisive via primary-source fetch (toupie 1803.10310 class definition excludes A0; Bocklandt 2304.10223 treats a different infinite-dimensional closed-surface construction; Opper graded-gentle and skew-gentle give class-level theorems with no A0 table; Ladkani duplicate adds nothing). None names the exact Markov quiver with cut c0 and relations a1b1=a2b2=0, none tabulates its AG vector or HH2=0/HH1=k^2, and none evaluates its mixed HH1xHH2 action, so no equivalent formulation, broader theorem, database entry, or implied corollary covers the headline. Remaining hits are keyword-similar background (operadic calculus, torus orbifolds, theses, methods notes) with disjoint object classes. Hence no decisive prior, no incremental decisive recall, and originality PASS is preserved with correctness and value untouched.
